1.mascotDialogue: Nothing elaborate here — simply compare your neighbor, swap if you are larger, and repeat the entire sweep until nothing needs swapping anymore.

2.mascotDialogue: `n minus i minus 1` on line 3 shrinks the inner loop's range each pass — the last i elements are already sorted, no need to check them again.

3.mascotDialogue: Watch the tallest bar creep one step right with every swap it loses — this is the 'bubbling' the algorithm is named for, made entirely literal.

4.mascotDialogue: This one will not crash every time — that is the quiet danger. It will simply, occasionally, read garbage past the array — exactly the kind of mistake that slips by, because it does not always announce itself.
